text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……Alright! Trainer, all good over there?
Not wobbling?

Yeah, solid. Tent is up……
All set for Special Training Camp.

Yeah, solid. Tent is up……
All set for Special Training Camp.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Right! Less like camp,
more like mountain retreat vibe?
Totally fine though, bring it on!

……That's the spirit, Pandora.
Whoops,
look at time…… Better go meet them.

……That's the spirit, Pandora.
Whoops,
look at time…… Better go meet them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
——My,
look at that!
The leading lady has arrived.
Fufu,
carefree dorm smile seems completely gone.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the wait.
Preparations complete on our side.

Thanks for coming.
Appreciate the help starting today.

Thanks for coming.
Appreciate the help starting today.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Osu, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Though, one thing I want to say first.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heart-chan, everyone.
You don't need to coach me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: My? ……Care to explain what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
My senior is Ku-chan-senpai.
……She already taught me everything.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So race against me instead.
Like I'm your rival.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……Please. Give me everything you've got!
Just like you did with senpai!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Understood. ……No soft treatment requested.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
——Then no holding back.
We shall crush you as many times as it
takes!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Come strike, Fusaichi Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aha! ——You're on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Goodness…… she really is transforming.
To think Pandora-san would propose such
rigorous camp herself.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
At Shuka Sho, truth is……
Felt like I ran harder than ever.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
All through training, during race itself.
Gave every drop I had.
Truly my absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ——Even then, still lost.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. ……Wasn't a prodigy after all.
Stay like this,
Queen Elizabeth II Cup is lost too.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
But…… that's why!
Refuse to stay weak like this!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Please, Trainer.
Need to become stronger……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Have to, starting right now!
Because…… because I——!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Phew-………… Alright.
——Let's do this, Trainer!

And so——surrounded by towering legends,
Fusaichi Pandora's Training Camp begins!

text_block_list.name: Team <Ascella>
text_block_list.text: One-two…… push it, Pandora———!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oooosu——! Phew—, whew—…… Nnnghhghghgh……!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, plant feet firmly! One more set,
Pandora-san!

Grind will be dull and repetitive……
Stay strong,
Pandora!
Solid foundation required to level up!

Grind will be dull and repetitive……
Stay strong,
Pandora!
Solid foundation required to level up!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I know…… already! Not done yet～～～!

(Teammates backing her,
morning spent hammering basics……!
Then afternoon——)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ——Alright, picking up pace… NOW!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngh……! Haa, haa, haa……!

Hold your pace! Watch runners around you,
but keep vision wide!
Read the entire pack dynamic!

Hold your pace! Watch runners around you,
but keep vision wide!
Read the entire pack dynamic!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Un-……derstood……reading, reading～……!

Yes, perfect! Final stretch left……
Closing in from behind, hold line,
Pandora!

Yes, perfect! Final stretch left……
Closing in from behind, hold line,
Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Messiah & Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaa—!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hold, hold! Hold hold hold……
Uuuwaaaaahh—————!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Different bond than yours,
but I admire Kraft too. In that sense,
guess that makes me your senpai?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So carrying her light forward——
with resolve befitting a "Queen",
legs will not falter here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still standing on battle's front lines!
Pushing forward!
Zero intention of surrendering the Queen's
crown!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Carrying those feelings in chest…… inheriting
them as strength to charge into tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Do you truly grasp the weight of that mission?
Of that prestige?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let us see. Rather,
ensure you learn.
Until scorched into flesh and soul——
we carve it in directly.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Queen Elizabeth II Cup gathers Tiara Uma
Musume across generations.
Stage determining supreme ruler.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Precisely why I etch myself into that legacy.
……As a reigning "Queen",
I block your path.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Step forward, Fusaichi Pandora.
Dual-Crown Queen Cesario stands before
you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Not yet…… Not yet!
Just one more……!

(Afternoons spent challenging Kraft's rivals!
Honing race instincts,
gathering grit…… transforming into true
contender!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaah—————!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa…… *cough*……
Haha, brutal……

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Still…… won't ever give up……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Not a prodigy. Nowhere close!
Triple Tiara swept clean out of reach!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Was weak! Lacked so much!
Even so……!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, senpai always——!
Always believed in me——!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
『You'll be okay, absolutely!
Because Pandora-san's future will surely
be——』

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
『Brighter,
more wonderful than anything seen before.
You can do this, Pandora-san!』

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Ku-chan-senpai always, always.
Believed in me!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (That is why…… I will——!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
……Time. Let us begin.
Return to campus tomorrow,
making today final parallel trial.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now then.
Haven't taken lead once yet——
surely don't intend to let camp end like
that?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Heh. Save that chat for after the run!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
Show the fruits of your training today!

……Alright, all lined up.
Ready——

……Alright, all lined up.
Ready——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa——!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
『You shine so bright.
Uma Musume packed full of everyone's
hopes——』

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(She cared for me, believed in me!
Senpai gave me everything!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (So I will——! I will deliver!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (I will carry the torch!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ——Aaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I'll do it! Bridge the link!
Become Ku-chan-senpai's legacy!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Senpai gave everything to me!
She runs beside me. Always with me!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Not over yet! Only just begun……!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Fusaichi Pandora! Osu,
haaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(I won't let them!
I'll be that link—I will win!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (I'll become it! Senpai's——hope!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'll be one to do it! ——To do iiiiiiitt!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haa……! Haa, haa, haa……—— 
……Congrats.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you held out till very end. 
That run was just like——

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
……No, saying that might be presumptuous. 
Still, splendid work, Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ……Fruits of your hard effort.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Pandora-san. 
We're……entrusting it to you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……——Mm-hmm!
